subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm/madvise: skip zone device folios in cold/pageout PMD range

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the madvise_cold_or_pageout_pte_range function, which incorrectly ages or reclaims zone device memory when it should be skipped. The issue arises from the fact that the surrounding guards do not cover all cases of zone device memory, allowing present PMDs to be aged or paged out. To fix this, the patch explicitly skips ZONE_DEVICE folios during MADV_COLD/PAGEOUT operations.
